posts.title: Visual Regression Testing: The Most Important Test You're Not Running
posts.description: Your tests can pass while your app looks broken. Visual regression testing catches the UI bugs that unit, integration and E2E tests miss - and here is how to set it up with Percy, Chromatic or Vitest Browser Mode

posts.title: React Testing Questions That Trip Up Engineers
posts.description: Think you know your way around a test suite? These React testing interview questions cover act(), debounced inputs, mocking pitfalls, IntersectionObserver, and more. They can be harder than they look.

posts.title: Code Smells when you get AI to write your Frontend Tests
posts.description: AI is very powerful, but it can introduce lots of subtle code smells when it generates code for your frontend applications. Here are the main ones to look out for.
